# Claude/Windsurf Guidance for Sitecore Content SDK Angular Project

## Project Context
This is a Sitecore Content SDK application built with Angular, TypeScript, and Angular SSR. The project integrates with SitecoreAI (XM Cloud) for headless content management. An Express server in `src/server.ts` serves the rendered app, editing endpoints, sitemap, robots.txt, and personalization middleware.

## Architecture Overview
- **Framework**: Angular 21 with server-side rendering (`@angular/ssr`)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **CMS**: SitecoreAI / XM Cloud (headless)
- **SDK**: `@sitecore-content-sdk/angular`
- **Server**: Express (`src/server.ts`), started in production with `npm run serve:ssr`
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS plus component CSS under `src/assets/components`
- **Internationalization**: `@ngx-translate/core` with the Sitecore dictionary loader
- **Routing**: A locale-aware catch-all route in `src/app/app.routes.ts`
- **Data loading**: Route loaders in `src/content-sdk/loaders` (page, dictionary, 404, 500)

## Folder Layout
```
src/
  app/
    components/        # Sitecore renderings (*.component.ts)
    pages/             # Page, 404, and 500 route components
    shared/            # Layout (header, main, footer placeholders)
    app.routes.ts
    app.config.ts
  content-sdk/
    client/            # SitecoreClient singleton
    loaders/           # Page, dictionary, and error loaders
  assets/              # Tailwind entry and per-component CSS
  environments/        # Generated from .env by npm run gen:env
  server.ts            # Express SSR server
sitecore.config.ts     # Content SDK config
sitecore.cli.config.ts # Component map paths for sitecore-tools
```

## Development Principles

### Code Organization
- Keep one Sitecore rendering per `*.component.ts` file under `src/app/components`
- Extend `SxaComponent` for standard SXA renderings so styles and rendering ids stay consistent
- Put page-level route components in `src/app/pages`
- Fetch Sitecore data in loaders, not inside component constructors
- Register new renderings by placing them on a path listed in `sitecore.cli.config.ts` (`src/app/components`)

### TypeScript Standards
- Type Sitecore fields with the SDK field types (`Field`, `TextField`, `LinkField`)
- Define a fields interface per component
- Avoid `any`
- Read field values through computed signals when the component uses the Angular signals style already in this app

### Angular Patterns
- Standalone components with inline templates
- Use Angular control flow (`@if`, `@for`) in templates
- Inject Sitecore context with `inject(SitecoreContextService)`
- Client hydration is disabled in `app.config.ts` so router links attach correctly. Do not turn on `provideClientHydration()` without retesting in-app navigation

## Sitecore Integration Patterns

### Content Fetching
- Use `getClient()` from `src/content-sdk/client/sitecore-client.ts`
- Page data is loaded by `pageLoader`, which calls `getPage`, `getPreview`, or `getDesignLibraryData`
- Pass personalization variant ids from the request into `getPage`
- Dictionary phrases are loaded by `dictionaryLoader` for the current site and locale

### Component Development
- Render Sitecore fields with SDK directives such as `*scText`, `*scRichText`, `*scLink`, and `sc-placeholder`
- Check that a field exists before rendering it
- Show the Sitecore field name in brackets when the field is empty, matching the other components in this app
- Export the component class as the default export so the component map can pick it up

### Field Handling
```typescript
interface TitleFields {
  data?: { datasource?: { field?: { jsonValue?: Field<string> } } };
}

// Template
@if (titleField(); as title) {
  <span *scText="title"></span>
}
```

### Placeholders
The layout renders three placeholders from the Sitecore route:

- `headless-header`
- `headless-main`
- `headless-footer`

```html
<sc-placeholder name="headless-main" [rendering]="scRoute()!"></sc-placeholder>
```

## Server and Middleware
`src/server.ts` wires, in order:

- `GET /healthz`
- `POST /api/revalidate` for on-demand cache refresh
- `/sitemap.xml`, `/sitemap-{id}.xml`, and `/robots.txt`
- `/api/editing/config`, experimental features, and `/api/editing/render`
- Multisite, bot tracking, redirects, and personalization middleware
- `/_data` for client-side route data
- The Angular SSR engine for every other request

Personalization needs an Edge context id. It does not run against local containers.

## Environment
- Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in Sitecore values
- Only `CSDK_PUBLIC_*` variables are copied into Angular environment files
- `npm run dev` runs `gen:env:dev` before the dev server starts
- `npm run build` runs `gen:env:prod` before the production build
- Do not commit `.env` or `.env.dev`

## Performance
- The Express server gzip-compresses responses
- Page loaders can use the in-memory loader cache configured in `src/server.ts`
- Static browser files are served with a long cache lifetime
- Keep Sitecore API calls in loaders so they run once per request on the server

## Security
- Keep Edge context ids and API keys in `.env`, not in source
- `CSDK_PUBLIC_*` values are exposed to the browser. Do not put secrets behind that prefix
- When `SITECORE_REVALIDATE_SECRET` is set, callers of `POST /api/revalidate` must send the same value in the `x-revalidate-secret` header
- The server disables the `X-Powered-By` header

## Code Quality
- Components: `kebab-case.component.ts`, class names in PascalCase (`TitleComponent`)
- Selectors: `app-` prefix (`app-title`)
- Run `npm run lint` before committing
- `npm test` runs the Angular unit test builder. This starter does not yet include spec files

## Development Workflow
1. `cd examples/kit-angular-skate-park`
2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and set the Sitecore values
3. `npm install`
4. `npm run dev`
5. Production: `npm run build` then `npm run serve:ssr`

The editing host name in `xmcloud.build.json` is `angularstarter`. The cloud run command is `serve:ssr`.

## Best Practices Summary
1. Render Sitecore fields with SDK directives
2. Type every component's fields
3. Load layout and dictionary data in loaders
4. Keep new renderings under `src/app/components` so the component map includes them
5. Leave hydration disabled unless navigation is retested
6. Put browser-safe config in `CSDK_PUBLIC_*` and secrets in unprefixed env vars
7. Follow the existing SXA component pattern (`SxaComponent`, `component` CSS classes, rendering id)
8. Match empty-field placeholders to the other components in this app
